data.body: [operator-attested] Live post-merge cancellation evidence now satisfies the final AC. Organic same-change pair: change 1790 PS3 run 31846910968 was created 22:30:56Z; PS4 replacement run 31847788055 was created 22:44:30Z. The stale run ended canceled at 22:45:48Z, 78s after replacement creation. Its macOS job stopped at 22:45:31Z (61s), and still-running mutation gates stopped at 22:44:47-49Z (17-19s); the successor clear-vote job began 22:45:50Z without waiting for the old macOS/mutation work to finish naturally. Independent repeat: PS4 run 31847788055 was superseded by PS5 run 31849555779 at 23:12:58Z; stale macOS stopped at 23:14:34Z (96s) and the run ended canceled at 23:14:48Z (110s). Gerrit metadata in the logs proves the patchset pairs (1790 PS3->PS4->PS5). This is runner-capacity savings, not a claim about successful-run average wall time. All implementation, RED/GREEN/mutation proof, gates, merge SHA 4cbaa19315, and now live replacement evidence are complete.
